artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan: Gate 8 opt-in --jobs auto with VERIFY_DEPLOY_GATE8_JOBS override, a deterministic test-run-all-parallel.sh nested-inheritance fix, baseline/parallel measurement decision gate, and deploy-headless.sh --skip-verify with exit 4 / RESULT=landed_verify_skipped threaded by the two genuine callers.

memory_candidates.content: When adding a new exit code to a shell script whose exit-code contract has many nominal consumers, first re-derive which files GENUINELY execute it (command position) versus merely MENTION it in remedy strings or comments -- in this repo a 16-file 'caller' list collapsed to 2 real invokers. Then check each real caller's branch predicate shape: a caller written as `if rc -eq 1 || rc -eq 2; then <not-landed> else <landed> fi` is already exit-code-partition-compatible, so a new code routes into the existing else branch with zero control-flow edits. That is a structural guarantee of 'no other caller changes', not a claim needing per-caller testing -- and it makes an opt-in flag plus a NEW distinct exit code strictly safer than reusing 0 (which misrepresents a suppressed check as a passed one) or an existing failure code.
